figures.finding: Malawi has no child-performer permit: no person under fourteen may be employed or work in any public or private agricultural, industrial or non-industrial undertaking, save work in homes and in supervised vocational or training institutions; no exception for performing exists, so the general bar reaches child actors and any young writer or director employed alike (reading).
figures.applies: Employment Act 2000 (No. 6 of 2000) s. 21, the Ministry of Labour's copy.

sources.said: 21.--(1) Subject to subsection (2). no person under the age of fourteen shall be employed or work in any public or private agricultural, industrial or non- industrial undertaking or any branch thereof. (2) Subsection (1) shall not apply to work done in homes, vocational technical schools or other training institutions;
